draft_phrase_being_qualified: The common prereading note called T_g the actual cohomology parallel transport of the chosen clockwise based loop.
exact_maps: For the clockwise root deck generator g_j, the supplied action on the filled cover has vertical linear part A_j and acts by g_j(s)=exp(-2*pi*i/m_j)s on the base.
A clockwise base loop lifts from s to g_j(s). Returning its endpoint to the initial fibre applies g_j^{-1}; thus its geometric homology transport in that local marking is A_j^{-1}.

The induced cohomology parallel transport is (A_j^{-1})^{-t}=A_j^t. The covariant action of the deck transformation g_j on the pulled-back coefficient module is the inverse-dual map T_j=A_j^{-t}. Therefore the geometric clockwise transport is T_j^{-1}, whereas T_j is the left deck-module action used by the conjugation formulas.

The positive counterclockwise loop in current Paper I ends at g_j^{-1}(s), returns by g_j, and accordingly has homology transport A_j and cohomology transport A_j^{-t}. This proves the exact relation of both conventions.

Because A_j has order m_j, N(T_j^{-1})=sum_{k=0}^{m_j-1}T_j^{-k}=sum_{k=0}^{m_j-1}T_j^k=N(T_j). The common invariant submodule and submodule generated by (T_j-I)V are preserved: (T_j^{-1}-I)V=-T_j^{-1}(T_j-I)V.

In the crossed-homomorphism formulas, g denotes the chosen deck-group element and T_g its inverse-dual coefficient action; the based product rho_1 rho_2 rho_0=1 is used with the given zero-section lifts. No equality between the positive-meridian product and the product of naive individual inverse matrices is asserted.
